ways.label: Long Gully car park to Timaru Creek Road (complete Grandview Ridge Track)
ways.distance: 43.5 km to exit via Breast Hill Track, 37.5 km to exit before the Breast Hill Track junction via Pakituhi Hut
evidence: This is the complete Grandview Ridge Track (previously known as Grandview Range Track) and provides great views of the upper Clutha Valley and the peaks beyond.
Follow the Timaru Creek/Breast Hill Track to Pakituhi Hut. Grandview Ridge Junction is 300 m past this hut.

ways.label: Long Gully car park to Nook Road carpark
evidence: Nook Road carpark - approximately 5 km from Hāwea township.
Travel for 500 m before reaching the Nook Road carpark and the beginning of the Grandview Mountain Track. Walk or bike up this track for 9 km before reaching Grandview Ridge Track.

evidence: The track starts across the road from the Sandy Point car park.
A poled route follows the toe of the hill before climbing up Deep Gully and up onto the Grandview Ridge.
Turn right to follow the Grandview Ridge track for 500 m before branching off and descending down the Eastern Hills track back to the starting point.

doubts: This is a network page with several options. Long Gully car park has no road end feature in the packet (start ref null). The complete Grandview Ridge Track (W1) has two exits (via Breast Hill Track, 43.5 km, or before the Breast Hill Track junction via Pakituhi Hut, 37.5 km); the page does not describe the exits clearly, so the via order and whether Pakituhi Hut is on the longer exit are uncertain; Timaru Creek Road has no feature. Nook Road carpark is matched to F3 (where Grandview Mountain Track meets Hawea Back Road) because the text puts the carpark at the beginning of Grandview Mountain Track, though the text names Nook Road, not Hāwea Back Road. The Sandy Point ends of the Deep Gully way and the loop are matched to F1 (Deep Gully Track at the road, across from the car park); the Eastern Hill Track end has no matching feature. The text's 'Eastern Hill Track' is assumed to be the map's Eastern Hills Track (T3). Shapes of W1 and W2 are taken as one_way from their 'car park to car park' headings.
